rows.responsibility: Premium entitlement/subscription/commerce settings orchestration: server-configured feature order, account entitlement state, subscription options/prices, source-ref attribution, gift/status contexts, promo telemetry and trusted purchase routing.
rows.state_machine: enter exact account/ref -> reload entitlement/options -> project ordered features -> choose option/context -> resolve trusted purchase route or fail closed -> handoff -> reconcile entitlement; teardown pauses derived animation/media only
rows.side_effects: Reload entitlement/options, emit promo show/accept events, open preview, resolve trusted bot/invoice route, start purchase handoff.
rows.failure_cases: account switch/window mismatch; unavailable premium; empty/stale option; invalid route; duplicate activation; cancel/provider failure/settlement race; stale amount/currency; missing gift/status context; teardown after async media load
rows.ui_disposition: Reuse canonical Settings/ProfileSection/ListRow/Radio/Button/Toast/DetailPanel and existing commerce surfaces; no Telegram Premium UI/runtime.
rows.fabushi_canonical_owner: Canonical Entitlement/Subscription + Wallet/Payments/Commerce + Settings + Identity/Account + design system
rows.platform_differences: External payment/browser launch is bounded adapter; entitlement/settlement truth remains canonical and account-scoped.
rows.production_evidence: Exact source read; canonical production closure and same-head evidence open.
rows.test_evidence: account-switch/stale option fencing; invalid-route fail-closed; duplicate idempotency; cancel/failure/settlement/reload/restart reconciliation; option/currency refresh; gift/status context loss; keyboard/focus/a11y/light-dark/responsive/reduced-motion; packaged commerce acceptance
rows.reachability_status: accepted-tree premium settings and purchase orchestration proven; canonical closure open
rows.license_and_provenance: tdesktop provenance retained; no payment credential material in evidence.
rows.notes: Full exact-source read; no unknown credit.
